# fluenteGRE

> Bilingual GRE vocabulary trainer for non-native English speakers.

fluenteGRE is a free, browser-based GRE vocabulary study tool designed specifically for bilingual learners. It helps Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian speakers master 1,184 high-frequency GRE words using their native language as a bridge.

## What it does

- 1,184 GRE vocabulary words organized into 31 study sets of ~40 words each
- Full bilingual support: every word has a translation, native-language definition, and memory trick in Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian
- Flashcards with spaced repetition and self-rating (Again / Hard / Good / Easy)
- Multiple quiz modes: definition matching, translation quizzes, and timed pair matching
- Progress tracking with mastery scores, streak counting, and per-word analytics
- Browse mode organized by 23 thematic groups (e.g., Speech & Rhetoric, Moral Judgment, Quantity & Degree)
- Works entirely in the browser with no account required — progress saves to localStorage

## Who it's for

- Non-native English speakers preparing for the GRE General Test
- Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian speakers who want to leverage their native language to learn English vocabulary faster
- Graduate school applicants looking for free, high-quality GRE vocab prep
- Self-directed learners who prefer flashcard and quiz-based study methods

## How it helps bilingual learners

Each vocabulary word includes a carefully chosen translation in the learner's native language, a definition written in that language, and a mnemonic trick that connects the English word to something familiar in their language. This dual-encoding approach — seeing the word in both English and your native language — has been shown to improve retention compared to English-only study methods.
